method: Simulation integration unit tests with deterministic civilian service fixtures; real civilian voxel raycasting and swept vehicle geometry are verified separately.

results.test: Unarmed proximity remains neutral for60simulated seconds; monoblade API is absent
Two60damage shots injure then kill; casualty and security kill counts stay distinct, death emits once
Building cover prevents civilian damage while public fire still raises an alert
A supply cell or security drone in front of a civilian receives the shot
A civilian in front of cover receives the shot before the more distant obstacle
Low speed, stationary vehicle and accepted motion without impact cause no crime
Reverse impacts preserve accepted sweep/options and actual direction; death feedback cannot repeat
Nonlethal vehicle injuries create assault status, and reset restores civilians and permits a new death event
